summary: CICS online Transaction-Type (reference data) List screen. Displays a scrollable, paginated list of transaction type/category reference records, optionally filtered by type code, with forward/backward paging. The user can select a type to view or maintain it. Pseudo-conversational, carrying paging position and filter in the COMMAREA. (Large program -- key logic paragraphs summarized; the remainder are screen-array setup and attribute boilerplate.)

paragraphs.name: 0000-MAIN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Pseudo-conversational entry. On first entry send the first (optionally filtered) page of transaction-type records. On re-entry evaluate the key: PF3 return; PF7 page backward; PF8 page forward; Enter apply filter or select a row. Return to CICS with the COMMAREA.
branches: EVALUATE EIBAID: PF3 / PF7 / PF8 / ENTER

annotations.note: Paged reference-data list; paging state carried in COMMAREA.

paragraphs.name: 1000-SEND-MAP
paragraphs.pseudocode: Build and send the transaction-type list map: initialize the screen and its row array, set attributes and message, then transmit.
paragraphs.notes: Screen send orchestrator (array setup paragraphs omitted as boilerplate).

paragraphs.name: 1200-SCREEN-ARRAY-INIT
paragraphs.pseudocode: Fill the on-screen array with the current page of transaction-type rows (type code, category, description).

paragraphs.name: 2000-RECEIVE-MAP
paragraphs.pseudocode: Receive the map and validate the filter and any selected row.

paragraphs.name: 2200-EDIT-INPUTS
paragraphs.pseudocode: Validate the type-code filter (if entered) and the row selection (exactly one, valid action character).

annotations.note: BUSINESS RULE: type filter must be valid; exactly one row may be selected.

paragraphs.name: 9000-READ-FORWARD
paragraphs.pseudocode: Browse the transaction-type file forward from the current position, applying the filter, filling the next page until full or end-of-file.
branches: STARTBR/READNEXT loop until page full or EOF

paragraphs.name: 9100-READ-BACKWARDS
paragraphs.pseudocode: Browse the transaction-type file backward from the current position, applying the filter, filling the previous page until full or top-of-file.
branches: STARTBR/READPREV loop until page full or BOF

paragraphs.name: 9500-FILTER-RECORDS
paragraphs.pseudocode: Skip transaction-type records that do not match the active type-code filter.
branches: IF matches filter -> include ELSE skip

annotations.note: BUSINESS RULE: only transaction types matching the filter are listed.

paragraphs.name: COMMON-RETURN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Save paging/filter state to the COMMAREA and CICS RETURN with the transaction id.
